programs.name: Cybersecurity

programs.name: Information Systems

programs.name: Industrial Design
programs.description: Human-centred design of manufactured products, from research and sketching to prototype.

programs.name: Aviation Management
programs.description: Business and operations management for airlines, airports and aviation services.

programs.name: Construction Management
programs.school: College of Engineering and Applied Technology
programs.description: Planning, estimating and delivering building and infrastructure projects.

programs.name: Biomedical Technology
programs.school: College of Engineering and Applied Technology
programs.description: Medical device technology, instrumentation and clinical engineering support.

programs.name: Supply Chain Management
programs.description: Planning and managing the flow of goods, information and finance across supply networks.

programs.name: Renewable Energy
programs.school: College of Engineering and Applied Technology
programs.description: Technology, economics and policy of solar, wind and storage systems.

programs.name: Statistics

courses.name: Introduction to Engineering Design
courses.description: Team-based introduction to the engineering design process, sketching and basic CAD modelling.
courses.learningOutcomes: Apply the design process to a small project; produce dimensioned sketches and a CAD model; communicate design decisions in a short report.

topics.title: The design process
topics.description: Problem definition, concept generation, selection matrices and iteration.

topics.title: Sketching and orthographic projection
topics.description: Freehand and dimensioned views of parts and assemblies.

topics.title: Parametric CAD basics
topics.description: Sketches, features and assemblies in a solid modelling package.

topics.title: Design reports and teamwork
topics.description: Documenting requirements, decisions and test results as a team.

courses.name: Statics and Mechanics of Materials
courses.description: Equilibrium of particles and rigid bodies followed by stress, strain and deformation of structural members.
courses.learningOutcomes: Draw free-body diagrams; solve equilibrium problems; compute stress and deflection in bars and beams.

topics.title: Free-body diagrams and equilibrium
topics.description: Forces, moments and support reactions in two and three dimensions.

topics.title: Trusses and frames
topics.description: Method of joints and sections for statically determinate structures.

topics.title: Axial, torsional and bending stress
topics.description: Stress and strain relationships for common loadings.

topics.title: Beam deflection
topics.description: Shear and moment diagrams and deflection by integration.

courses.name: Thermodynamics I
courses.description: Properties of pure substances and the first and second laws applied to closed and open systems.
courses.learningOutcomes: State and apply the first and second laws; use property tables; evaluate simple power and refrigeration cycles.

topics.title: Properties and state
topics.description: Phase diagrams, steam tables and ideal gas behaviour.

topics.title: First law for control volumes
topics.description: Energy balances for turbines, pumps and heat exchangers.

topics.title: Entropy and the second law
topics.description: Reversibility, isentropic efficiency and entropy generation.

courses.name: Machine Component Design
courses.description: Design of shafts, fasteners, bearings and gears with attention to fatigue and failure theories.
courses.learningOutcomes: Select and size machine elements; apply failure criteria; justify safety factors.

topics.title: Failure theories
topics.description: Maximum shear, distortion energy and fracture considerations.

topics.title: Fatigue life
topics.description: S-N curves, stress concentration and endurance limits.

topics.title: Shafts and fasteners
topics.description: Sizing shafts, keys, bolted joints and preload.

topics.title: Gears and bearings
topics.description: Spur gear geometry, rolling bearing selection and life.

courses.name: Heat Transfer and Thermal Systems
courses.description: Conduction, convection and radiation with applications to heat exchangers and electronics cooling.
courses.learningOutcomes: Solve steady and transient conduction problems; size a heat exchanger; estimate radiative exchange.

topics.title: Steady conduction and fins
topics.description: One-dimensional conduction, thermal resistance networks and extended surfaces.

topics.title: Forced and natural convection
topics.description: Correlations for internal and external flows.

courses.name: Introduction to Cybersecurity
courses.description: Survey of threats, attack techniques and defensive controls, with hands-on lab exercises.
courses.learningOutcomes: Describe common attack classes; apply basic hardening; explain confidentiality, integrity and availability trade-offs.

topics.title: Threat landscape
topics.description: Malware, phishing, social engineering and ransomware case studies.

topics.title: The CIA triad and security controls
topics.description: Preventive, detective and corrective controls mapped to risks.

topics.title: Passwords and authentication
topics.description: Hashing, multi-factor authentication and credential attacks.

topics.title: Safe lab practice
topics.description: Isolated virtual labs and responsible disclosure.

courses.name: Network Defense and Monitoring
courses.description: Firewalls, intrusion detection and traffic analysis on enterprise-style lab networks.
courses.learningOutcomes: Configure a firewall policy; analyse packet captures; tune an intrusion detection system.

topics.title: Packet analysis
topics.description: Reading captures to identify scans, tunnels and exfiltration.

topics.title: Firewall rule design
topics.description: Stateful filtering, segmentation and DMZ architecture.

topics.title: IDS and log correlation
topics.description: Signature and anomaly detection and central log review.

courses.name: Applied Cryptography
courses.description: Symmetric and public-key cryptography, hashing and protocol use in practice.
courses.learningOutcomes: Choose appropriate primitives; explain key exchange; identify common implementation mistakes.

topics.title: Symmetric ciphers and modes
topics.description: Block ciphers, modes of operation and authenticated encryption.

topics.title: Public-key cryptography
topics.description: RSA, elliptic curves and digital signatures.

topics.title: Certificates and TLS
topics.description: Public key infrastructure and the TLS handshake.

courses.name: Ethical Hacking and Penetration Testing
courses.description: Authorised testing methodology from reconnaissance to reporting.
courses.learningOutcomes: Plan a scoped engagement; exploit common web and host weaknesses in a lab; write a remediation report.

topics.title: Reconnaissance and scanning
topics.description: Enumeration of hosts, services and exposed applications.

topics.title: Web application attacks
topics.description: Injection, broken access control and session weaknesses.

topics.title: Post-exploitation and reporting
topics.description: Privilege escalation, evidence handling and findings reports.

courses.name: Security Risk and Governance
courses.description: Risk assessment, policy, compliance frameworks and incident response planning.
courses.learningOutcomes: Perform a qualitative risk assessment; map controls to a framework; draft an incident response plan.

topics.title: Risk assessment methods
topics.description: Asset valuation, threat modelling and likelihood-impact matrices.

topics.title: Incident response planning
topics.description: Preparation, containment, recovery and lessons learned.

courses.name: Foundations of Information Systems
courses.description: How organisations use information systems to support operations, decisions and strategy.
courses.learningOutcomes: Describe the components of an information system; map a business process; evaluate a system proposal.

topics.title: Components of information systems
topics.description: Hardware, software, data, people and processes.

topics.title: Business process modelling
topics.description: Flowcharts and swimlane diagrams for operational processes.

courses.name: Database Design and SQL
courses.description: Relational modelling, normalisation and query writing against a production-style database.
courses.learningOutcomes: Design a normalised schema; write joins and aggregates; enforce integrity constraints.

topics.title: Normalisation
topics.description: Functional dependencies through third normal form.

topics.title: Transactions and indexing
topics.description: ACID properties and basic performance tuning.

courses.name: Systems Analysis and Requirements
courses.description: Eliciting, documenting and validating requirements for new systems.
courses.learningOutcomes: Run stakeholder interviews; write user stories and use cases; build a prioritised backlog.

topics.title: User stories and use cases
topics.description: Writing testable requirements and acceptance criteria.

topics.title: Prototyping and validation
topics.description: Wireframes and review cycles with users.

courses.name: Enterprise Systems Integration
courses.description: ERP concepts, APIs and data integration across enterprise applications.
courses.learningOutcomes: Explain ERP modules; consume a REST API; design a simple integration flow.

topics.title: ERP modules and workflows
topics.description: Finance, procurement and inventory processes in an ERP.

courses.name: IT Project Management
courses.description: Planning, scheduling and delivering technology projects using predictive and agile methods.
courses.learningOutcomes: Build a work breakdown structure; manage scope and risk; run an agile sprint cycle.

topics.title: Scope, schedule and cost
topics.description: Work breakdown structures, Gantt charts and earned value.

courses.name: Design Drawing and Visualisation
courses.description: Perspective sketching, rendering and presentation techniques for product concepts.
courses.learningOutcomes: Produce perspective sketches; render form and material; present concepts visually.

topics.title: Perspective and form
topics.description: One- and two-point perspective for product forms.

topics.title: Rendering materials
topics.description: Marker and digital rendering of plastics, metals and glass.

topics.title: Concept presentation boards
topics.description: Layout and storytelling for design reviews.

courses.name: Materials and Making
courses.description: Hands-on workshop in wood, metal, plastics and rapid prototyping.
courses.learningOutcomes: Select materials for a product; use shop tools safely; produce a working prototype.

topics.title: Workshop safety and tools
topics.description: Safe operation of hand and power tools.

topics.title: Plastics and thermoforming
topics.description: Properties and forming methods for common polymers.

topics.title: 3D printing and laser cutting
topics.description: Preparing files and iterating physical prototypes.

courses.name: Human Factors and Ergonomics
courses.description: Anthropometry, usability and the study of how people interact with products.
courses.learningOutcomes: Apply anthropometric data; plan a usability test; critique a product for accessibility.

topics.title: Anthropometry and posture
topics.description: Percentile data and design for the range of users.

topics.title: Usability testing
topics.description: Task analysis, think-aloud sessions and metrics.

topics.title: Inclusive design
topics.description: Designing for varied abilities and contexts.

courses.name: Product Design Studio
courses.description: Studio project taking a consumer product from user research through refined prototype.
courses.learningOutcomes: Frame a design brief from research; iterate prototypes; defend a final design.

topics.title: Research and brief writing
topics.description: Observation, interviews and design opportunity statements.

topics.title: Refinement and detailing
topics.description: Form, colour, material and finish decisions.

courses.name: Design for Manufacturing
courses.description: How processes such as injection moulding and sheet metal shape design decisions.
courses.learningOutcomes: Apply design-for-manufacture rules; estimate tooling cost; prepare production drawings.

topics.title: Injection moulding rules
topics.description: Draft, wall thickness and parting lines.

topics.title: Cost and assembly
topics.description: Part count reduction and tooling cost estimates.

courses.name: Introduction to Aviation
courses.description: History, structure and regulation of the aviation industry.
courses.learningOutcomes: Describe industry sectors; explain the role of regulators; identify key airport and airline functions.

topics.title: History of flight and the industry
topics.description: From early aviation to modern air transport.

topics.title: Regulation and safety oversight
topics.description: National and international regulators and standards.

courses.name: Airport Operations
courses.description: Airside and landside operations, security and capacity planning.
courses.learningOutcomes: Explain airfield layout; analyse terminal capacity; describe security screening processes.

topics.title: Airfield layout and ground handling
topics.description: Runways, taxiways, aprons and turnaround processes.

topics.title: Airport security and emergency planning
topics.description: Screening, access control and response drills.

courses.name: Aviation Safety Management Systems
courses.description: Safety culture, hazard identification and safety management system principles.
courses.learningOutcomes: Conduct a hazard analysis; interpret accident data; describe the four pillars of an SMS.

topics.title: Safety culture
topics.description: Just culture, reporting systems and human error.

courses.name: Airline Revenue and Network Planning
courses.description: Route economics, fleet decisions, pricing and revenue management.
courses.learningOutcomes: Estimate route profitability; explain yield management; compare fleet options.

topics.title: Route and network economics
topics.description: Load factor, yield and cost per available seat mile.

topics.title: Revenue management
topics.description: Fare classes, overbooking and demand forecasting.

courses.name: Aviation Law and Policy
courses.description: Legal framework for aviation including liability, labour and environmental policy.
courses.learningOutcomes: Summarise key conventions; analyse a liability case; evaluate an aviation policy proposal.

topics.title: International conventions
topics.description: Air law and sovereignty over airspace.

courses.name: Introduction to Construction
courses.description: Overview of construction project delivery, trades and site practice.
courses.learningOutcomes: Identify project delivery methods; read basic plans; describe site safety obligations.

topics.title: Delivery methods
topics.description: Design-bid-build, design-build and construction manager at risk.

courses.name: Construction Materials and Methods
courses.description: Properties and installation of concrete, steel, wood and masonry systems.
courses.learningOutcomes: Specify materials for a building element; explain sequencing; interpret quality tests.

courses.name: Estimating and Bidding
courses.description: Quantity takeoff, unit costs and bid preparation.
courses.learningOutcomes: Perform a quantity takeoff; price an assembly; assemble a competitive bid.

courses.name: Construction Scheduling and Control
courses.description: Critical path scheduling, resource levelling and progress tracking.
courses.learningOutcomes: Build a CPM network; level resources; update a schedule against actual progress.

topics.title: Critical path method
topics.description: Activity networks, float and critical paths.

courses.name: Contracts and Construction Law
courses.description: Contract documents, change orders, claims and dispute resolution.
courses.learningOutcomes: Interpret contract clauses; process a change order; compare dispute resolution routes.

courses.name: Introduction to Biomedical Technology
courses.description: Survey of medical devices, the healthcare environment and the technologist role.
courses.learningOutcomes: Name major device categories; describe regulatory oversight; explain the role of clinical engineering.

courses.name: Human Anatomy for Technologists
courses.description: Organ systems and physiology relevant to device use, with laboratory sessions.
courses.learningOutcomes: Describe major organ systems; relate physiology to device measurements; use anatomical terminology.

topics.title: Cardiovascular and respiratory systems
topics.description: Structure and function relevant to monitoring.

courses.name: Biomedical Instrumentation
courses.description: Sensors, amplifiers and signal acquisition for physiological measurement.
courses.learningOutcomes: Build a simple biosignal amplifier; reduce noise; calibrate a sensor.

topics.title: Biopotential electrodes
topics.description: ECG, EMG and EEG signal sources.

topics.title: Data acquisition
topics.description: Sampling and digitisation of physiological signals.

courses.name: Medical Imaging Technology
courses.description: Physical principles and equipment of X-ray, ultrasound, CT and MRI.
courses.learningOutcomes: Explain image formation in each modality; compare modality strengths; describe safety practices.

courses.name: Clinical Equipment Maintenance and Safety
courses.description: Preventive maintenance, electrical safety testing and equipment lifecycle management.
courses.learningOutcomes: Perform electrical safety tests; plan a maintenance schedule; document service records.

courses.name: Introduction to Supply Chain Management
courses.description: Overview of sourcing, production, distribution and the integration of supply networks.
courses.learningOutcomes: Map a supply chain; define key performance measures; explain the bullwhip effect.

topics.title: Performance metrics
topics.description: Cost, service level and cycle time.

courses.name: Procurement and Strategic Sourcing
courses.description: Supplier selection, negotiation and category management.
courses.learningOutcomes: Evaluate suppliers; prepare a negotiation plan; compute total cost of ownership.

courses.name: Inventory Management
courses.description: Models for stocking decisions under certain and uncertain demand.
courses.learningOutcomes: Compute economic order quantity; set safety stock; classify items by ABC analysis.

courses.name: Transportation and Distribution Networks
courses.description: Mode selection, routing and warehouse network design.
courses.learningOutcomes: Compare transport modes; solve a routing problem; locate a distribution centre.

topics.title: Mode selection and freight costs
topics.description: Truck, rail, ocean and air trade-offs.

courses.name: Supply Chain Analytics
courses.description: Forecasting, optimisation and dashboards for supply chain decisions.
courses.learningOutcomes: Build a demand forecast; formulate a linear programme; present a metrics dashboard.

topics.title: Demand forecasting
topics.description: Moving average, exponential smoothing and error measures.

courses.name: Introduction to Renewable Energy
courses.description: Survey of energy resources, renewable technologies and climate context.
courses.learningOutcomes: Compare energy sources; explain basic solar and wind conversion; interpret energy statistics.

topics.title: Global energy landscape
topics.description: Fossil fuels, nuclear and renewables in the energy mix.

courses.name: Photovoltaic Systems
courses.description: Solar cell physics, module characteristics and system sizing.
courses.learningOutcomes: Read an I-V curve; size an array and inverter; estimate annual energy yield.

topics.title: Modules and I-V curves
topics.description: Series and parallel connection and shading.

courses.name: Wind Energy Systems
courses.description: Aerodynamics, turbine components and wind farm siting.
courses.learningOutcomes: Compute power from wind speed; describe turbine subsystems; assess a site.

courses.name: Energy Storage and Grid Integration
courses.description: Battery technologies, power electronics and the challenges of variable generation.
courses.learningOutcomes: Compare storage technologies; explain inverter control; analyse a variable-generation profile.

courses.name: Energy Economics and Project Finance
courses.description: Levelised cost, incentives and financing structures for renewable projects.
courses.learningOutcomes: Calculate levelised cost of energy; model project cash flows; evaluate policy incentives.

topics.title: Levelised cost of energy
topics.description: Capital, operating cost and capacity factor.

courses.name: Introduction to Statistics
courses.description: Descriptive statistics, probability basics, confidence intervals and hypothesis tests.
courses.learningOutcomes: Summarise data graphically and numerically; construct confidence intervals; carry out common hypothesis tests.

topics.title: Descriptive statistics and graphs
topics.description: Measures of centre and spread, histograms and box plots.

topics.title: Probability and sampling distributions
topics.description: Random variables, the normal distribution and the central limit theorem.

courses.name: Probability Theory
courses.description: Discrete and continuous random variables, joint distributions and limit theorems.
courses.learningOutcomes: Compute expectations and variances; work with joint distributions; apply the law of large numbers.

topics.title: Random variables and distributions
topics.description: Binomial, Poisson, exponential and normal families.

topics.title: Limit theorems
topics.description: Law of large numbers and central limit theorem.

courses.name: Statistical Computing with R
courses.description: Data wrangling, visualisation and simulation in R.
courses.learningOutcomes: Import and clean data; produce publication-quality graphics; run a Monte Carlo simulation.

topics.title: Data import and wrangling
topics.description: Reading, reshaping and cleaning data frames.

topics.title: Visualisation
topics.description: Layered graphics for exploration and reporting.

courses.name: Regression Analysis
courses.description: Linear and generalised linear models with diagnostics and model selection.
courses.learningOutcomes: Fit and interpret regression models; check assumptions; select among competing models.

courses.name: Experimental Design and Quality Methods
courses.description: Designed experiments, ANOVA and statistical process control.
courses.learningOutcomes: Design a factorial experiment; analyse variance; construct control charts.
